subject: Falcon Media vendor setup — required PO fields, remit & tax evidence
messages:
From: Emily Walker <emily.walker@falconmedia.com>
To: soojin.lee@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@falconmedia.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding steps + PO fields for Redwood invoices

Hi Soojin,

We're starting vendor setup for Redwood in Falcon Media's procurement system (Ariba) ahead of the first POs. To avoid delays on invoice processing, could you confirm the following and send any onboarding packet you have:

- Legal entity name to appear on invoices
- Tax ID / W-9 (US) or VAT registration (EU) as applicable
- Remit-to address and preferred remit method (ACH/ Wire/ Check)
- Bank account details (routing, account, bank name) or ACH instructions — we can accept encrypted attachments via our portal
- Invoice email address and contact for billing disputes
- Any PO acceptance requirements (do you require invoice line items to match PO exactly, unit of measure constraints, or unit price tolerances?)

Our standard terms are Net45 unless otherwise negotiated; please let us know if Redwood requires Net30 or earlier. Also confirm whether Redwood will accept consolidated monthly invoices or prefers per-PO invoices.

If you can upload your vendor packet to our supplier portal (link below) we'll start the supplier verification. Otherwise attach the files here and I can load them.

Thanks,

Emily Walker
Senior Procurement Manager | Falcon Media
emily.walker@falconmedia.com
Procurement: procurement@falconmedia.com

Ariba supplier portal: https://ariba.falconmedia.com/supplier-portal/signup

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Walker <emily.walker@falconmedia.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, procurement@falconmedia.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding steps + PO fields for Redwood invoices

Hi Emily — thanks for the heads up. Attaching our AP packet and the signed W-9; banking instructions are provided in an encrypted PDF (Banking_Instructions_ENCRYPTED.pdf). Per your portal note we can also upload to Ariba if you prefer.

Quick answers to your questions:
- Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (please use exact spelling on the invoice)
- Tax ID: 27-3141592 (W-9 attached)
- Remit-to (preferred): ACH to account listed in encrypted banking attachment; wire available on request
- Invoice email: invoices@redwood.com; billing disputes to billing-ops@redwood.com
- PO acceptance: we follow a 2% tolerance on unit price and accept consolidated monthly invoices when POs are clearly referenced on line items. We can also do one invoice per PO if required.
- Terms: Standard Redwood public terms are Net30; if Falcon requires Net45 that is acceptable for this engagement but please confirm on the PO.

Open questions for your team: do you require a secondary contact phone number on invoices? Also, will Falcon's Ariba integration populate a supplier ID that we should reference on invoices (if so, please share once created)?

I've cc'd Marissa (revenue ops) to ensure our billing-side setup happens in parallel.

Attachments: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet.pdf (includes remit address, contact matrix, sample invoice), Redwood_W9_Form.pdf, Banking_Instructions_ENCRYPTED.pdf

Best,

Soojin Lee
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference platform

Thanks Soojin — that's very helpful. We will create a supplier record in Ariba; once created we'll send you the Supplier ID. A couple follow-ups from procurement: 

- Please confirm whether Redwood requires a PO number to be present on all invoices for payment (some business units will block otherwise).

I'll open the supplier record now; expect a confirmation email with Supplier ID. We'll also route a DocuSign to the email listed on your W-9 for ACH verification.

Emily

- We've uploaded the AP packet and W-9 to the HubSpot contact record and also to the secure section of our shared drive (link below). If you prefer, we can also upload directly to Ariba — let us know and we'll do it today.
